title: The Rods We Travel
description:
Here's a neat little bitta info for ya. Didcha know you can make sticks with rocks? It sounds silly, I know, but try it. And while you're at that, why not give crafting a rod template a shot? Simple stuff, really, just a few sticks and templates.
Tool rods can generally be better than basic sticks, and a template or blueprint ain't always needed for em, but consistency can be real nice.
